subject.description: Squash commit subject. Single line, no embedded newlines. When the PR title carries a type(TICKET-<n>): prefix, the subject must start with that exact prefix followed by a space (enforced in draft_schema.ts via ValidateOptions.requiredSubjectPrefix — not expressible here, since it depends on the PR title).

changelog_bullet.description: Single bullet line for CHANGELOG.md, starting with '- ' and ≤200 chars.
